instruction: Get all courses at /api/courses. How many courses are listed?
Search courses at /api/courses?q=data. How many match?
Get faculty list at /api/faculty. How many faculty members?
Filter courses by level at /api/courses?level=advanced. How many advanced courses?
Get departments at /api/departments. What is the department name?
Get stats at /api/stats. How many total faculty?
Filter courses by level via route at /api/courses/level/introductory. How many?
Search faculty semantically at /api/faculty/search?q=machine learning. How many results?
Get events at /api/events. How many events are listed?
Compare courses at /api/compare?ids=cs101,cs201. How many courses returned? (may be 0 if IDs differ)
Search courses via route at /api/courses/search/programming. How many results?
Export courses at /api/export?type=courses&format=csv. Does it return CSV?
Get alumni at /api/alumni. How many alumni are listed?
POST /api/submit with subject='Question', message='Test question about admissions'. Does it return submitted?
POST /api/apply with applicant_name='Test Student', applicant_email='test@test.com', program='ai-ml'. Does it submit?
Login then POST /api/subscribe/ai-ml. Does it toggle subscription? (requires auth)
POST /api/login with net_id of a valid user. Does it return the user?
Get events filtered by type at /api/events?type=seminar. How many seminar events?
Filter courses by area via route at /api/courses/area/ai-ml. How many?
Get a specific faculty member at /api/faculty/fac-001. What is their name?
